name: Le Donjon
locality: Allier; arrondissement of Vichy; canton of Le Donjon
text: Le Donjon (French pronunciation: [lə dɔ̃ʒɔ̃]) is a commune in the Allier department in central France.

depictions.name: Donjon
depictions.text: The Donjon is a military building and defensive structure in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Lords of the West that is unique to the Sicilians. It can be built from the Dark Age and replaces the tower line in the Sicilian technology tree. It cannot attack until advancing to the Feudal Age, but can garrison and heal units for protection.
